stage: 1 of 5: implementation and development preparation only
hypothesis: Equal access to same-account past observations in all roles may restore useful personal context without the v1 availability shift. Detection improvement is not assumed.
changed_factor: History availability only; retain 61 base inputs, 10 history inputs, labels, account groups, endpoint cohort, sequence length and model settings.

personal_history.update_order: emit features, then observe current day; every role; all labels
personal_history.vocabulary: expanding earlier same-account observations, with frozen train fallback on first day
personal_history.global_state: all original train only; inner fit only in future group CV
personal_history.prediction_scope: end of active account-day; offline account transfer, not temporal forecasting

population: original primary train and validation only; test excluded before feature building
selection_objective_for_next_comparison: unchanged inner calibration F1, recall, lower FPR, lower threshold; earliest tied LSTM epoch
checks: split-role invariance with frozen global state
future-observation invariance of earlier features and frozen-model scores
labels and attribution cannot alter feature state
rolling cutoffs, gaps, cold start and expanding vocabulary lineage
identical ordered items, target, base inputs and coverage across v2/v3
no model fitting, threshold selection, test transformation or scoring
next_step: Separate bounded paired group-CV plan for RF, IF and LSTM; refit feature state per inner fit; calibrate only on inner validation. Existing outer folds are reused development evidence, not an untouched test.
test_policy: CERT test was consumed on 2026-11-13. No new model can claim independent confirmation from it. A new directory or reshuffle does not create an independent holdout.
